title: The PARAMETERS line of a frozen refresh rule
description: Every number cardvision refresh verdict reads from a rule. See docs/refresh-rule-template.md. Beyond this schema, verdict also requires validity and regressions (and cumulative.regressions when present) to name exactly the datasets listed, and realFacesBySource.sources[*].runs to be run folders of the replay folder.

datasets.description: The replay's development sets, in the order they are judged; diff-<dataset>.json in the replay folder.

arms.description: Configurations scored on every dataset (for example without and with an optional stage). Absent or empty: one arm, and file and folder names carry no arm suffix; else diff-<dataset>-<arm>.json, cand-<arm>/, old-<arm>/.

rehearsalEnv.description: The environment variable that, set to 1, lets a rehearsal exclude events (default REFRESH_REHEARSAL). verdict --rehearsal does the same.

tolerancePt.description: Slack, in percentage points, on the rate limits of gate R, for floating-point rounding (default 1e-9; 0 compares exactly).

canary.description: Gate R needs a canary file in the replay folder with "ok": true (the frozen baseline release re-run in this session and equal to its pinned events), else INVALID.

validity.description: Per dataset: below these, the replay is INVALID.

regressions.description: Per dataset: the step limits, base to candidate.

cumulative.description: A second set of limits: the candidate against a fixed baseline release, applied unless the live release is that baseline. Needs diff-cum-<dataset>[-<arm>].json in the replay folder.

baseRun.description: The run folder, inside the replay folder, whose evaluate-hover.json names the base release.

realFacesBySource.description: Validity on real footage: each named source must hold at least minFaces readable faces in the base runs, counted from bySourceType of their evaluate-hover.json: every source type equal to one of its types or starting with one of its prefixes.

additionalProperties.description: runs, and types (exact source types) or prefixes or both

newcard.description: Gate N: the new cards on generated scenes, against a frozen reference of never-trained cards and against the live bank.

minNewCards.description: The fewest new cards with art the check accepts (default 1; 0 lets an empty set through to the other checks).

referenceDir.description: The frozen reference run, relative to the rule file's folder; {arm} is replaced by the arm's name.

n3.description: fewerWrong: the candidate gets strictly fewer faces wrong than the old bank. notWorseOneBetter: no fewer faces right, no more wrong, and an improvement in at least one (for games whose updates bring new artwork of cards the old bank can already name).

name.description: A dataset or arm name; canary, drawn and runs are refused, being names of rows of the verdict's detail.
